title: Aamir Khan Rejected Swades As He Found It 'Boring': 'Film Was Titled Kaveri Amma' - News18
text:
Aamir Khan Rejected Swades As He Found It 'Boring': 'Film Was Titled Kaveri Amma'
Swades, one of Shah Rukh Khan's finest films, was initially offered to Aamir Khan, who rejected it, finding the narration "boring". The 2004 film remains a classic.
Swades is still regarded as one of Shah Rukh Khan’s finest films to date. Not many know that the 2004 film was first offered to Aamir Khan by filmmaker Ashutosh Gowariker, who had previously collaborated with him for Lagaan. Years later, Aamir spoke about why he rejected the film. He said that the narration for Swades went on for three hours, and post the film’s reading, he found it to be very “boring".
After Lagaan (2001) became a blockbuster success, Ashutosh Gowariker was kneen on making his next film with Aamir. He pitched the idea of Swades to Aamir, only to be rejected. “I found it very boring," Aamir told Zoom, adding, “I had said this to Ashu when he narrated the story to me. In fact, I’ll tell you Ashu narrated the story to me when we were making Lagaan. It was titled Kaveri Amma then. That’s what he told me."
In the film, Kaveri Amma, portrayed by the late Kishori Ballal, was the foster mother of protagonist Mohan Bhargava. Aamir further recounted the events surrounding that moment. “I had liked the story very much. I said we’d make that one after Lagaan. After Lagaan released, we made Ashu sit with a writer. AKP (Aamir Khan Productions) was producing it," said Aamir.
He continued, “When the story was ready, Ashu narrated it to me. It was a three hour-long narration. When he asked me how I liked it, I said I want to tell you my first reaction first. I said, ‘I got bored. It’s very important for you to hear this reaction. What you’re trying to say is very correct, noble, and important, but if you say it in such a boring manner… I got bored, I don’t know about everyone else.'"
He shared that he initially turned down Gowariker’s offer, insisting he would only come on board if Swades could be made more engaging. “I’ve actually not seen the film yet. Maybe he’d have corrected it and people would’ve liked it then. I did note that people loved Shah Rukh’s work in it," said the actor.
About Swades
Shah Rukh Khan stars in Swades, portraying Mohan Bhargava, a successful NASA scientist who returns to India to find his childhood nanny, Kaveri Amma. His quest takes him to a rural village, where he reconnects with his heritage and is deeply affected by the local community’s challenges. The film addresses social responsibility, rural development, and the brain drain issue. With its touching story, strong performances, and AR Rahman’s soulful music, Swades remains a beloved classic that continues to inspire.
